steps.title: Configure App Meta and Package Declaration
steps.description: Establish package metadata with the name 'Study Planner Pro' and package namespace 'com.studyplannerpro.app'.

steps.title: Set Up Project Build Scripts and Environment
steps.description: Create base build configuration targeting Android API Level 34 with Java 17 toolchain compatibility and Java 8 source code settings.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with system notification, post-notification, and exact alarm permissions, registering the main activity and reminder receiver.

steps.title: Design App Theme and Brand Identity Colors
steps.description: Configure clean material style attributes, coloring primary fields, accents, and custom visual layers for optimal readability.

steps.title: Create Styling Drawables and UI Background Shapes
steps.description: Formulate custom XML assets to style task cards, input dialog fields, rounded tabs, and progressive indicators.

steps.title: Create Bottom Navigation Tab Selection Styles
steps.description: Construct state selectors to control button UI switching, highlighting active tabs inside the planner interface.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Activity Main Layout Hierarchy
steps.description: Produce complex single-activity structural container holding distinct tab blocks for Dashboard, Subject list, and Task view details.

steps.title: Construct Custom Item Rendering XML Templates
steps.description: Develop reusable layout layouts to represent task rows and subject cards with interactive completion controls.

steps.title: Create Add Dialog Interface Forms
steps.description: Establish quick overlays prompting inputs for subjects name, color highlights, task titles, and scheduling parameters.

steps.title: Implement Notification Broadcast Reminder Receiver
steps.description: Program ReminderReceiver.java using system notifications manager to sound notification events upon target scheduled periods.

steps.title: Implement Data Serialization and JSON Storage Manager
steps.description: Code persistent operations using SharedPreferences with parsing functions converting state datasets back and forth into readable models.

steps.title: Write Tab Control Interface Toggling Mechanics
steps.description: Configure action clicks to dynamic visibility switch blocks between dashboard insights, tasks, and subjects tables.

steps.title: Integrate Interactive Dialog Modal Trigger Interfaces
steps.description: Implement alerts to construct objects using user-input validation, updating lists on storage completions.

steps.title: Develop Progress Analytics and Dashboard Trackers
steps.description: Build real-time arithmetic calculations reporting task execution statistics by category, populating current performance percentages dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Task Completion Toggles and List Handlers
steps.description: Program callbacks update item status when checked, resetting overall progress and tracking dashboards instantly.

steps.title: Integrate AlarmManager Reminder Registration Pipelines
steps.description: Incorporate local AlarmManager pending triggers scheduling alerts corresponding directly with customized tasks timings settings.

steps.title: Building Study Planner Pro
steps.description: Build, compile, and package the complete planner app using default system parameters via gradle instructions.
